checkpoint5_full_extraction.engineeringSchemaIssue: RESOLVED 2026-09-29 by a restructuring pass (no re-extraction): engineering.json previously stored contentStandards as a SIBLING array of learningOutcomes on each subStrand instead of nested inside each learningOutcome. A Node.js script (data/curriculum/_fix_engineering_schema.js, retained alongside the file) read the whole file, re-nested each of the 36 Content Standards under its correct learningOutcome, and wrote the file back. Because every Content Standard's code shares its full subStrand-level prefix with all sibling Learning Outcome codes in this subject (e.g. CS '1.1.1.CS.1' vs LO '1.1.1.LO.1'/'1.1.1.LO.2'), prefix matching alone could never disambiguate the correct parent - every one of the file's 30 subStrands required reading Content Standard/Learning Indicator descriptions against Learning Outcome descriptions to confirm the mapping. 20 of the 30 subStrands (21 of the 36 Content Standards, minus 1 unambiguous case = 20 genuinely ambiguous CS-to-LO assignments) had more Learning Outcomes than Content Standards and required real topical judgment among multiple candidate Learning Outcomes, following the same CS-covers-multiple-LO convention already established in additional-mathematics.json/english-language.json: the Content Standard was nested under its closest topical-match Learning Outcome (with a reviewNote on that Content Standard documenting which Learning Indicators map to which other sibling Learning Outcome), and each orphaned sibling Learning Outcome got an empty contentStandards array, a cross-referencing reviewNote, and extractionStatus NEEDS_REVIEW. The remaining 10 subStrands had equal LO/CS counts (5 trivial 1:1, 5 with 2 LOs/2 CS where sequential order was confirmed unambiguous by content, e.g. 2.3.1.CS.1 'select an optimal solution' matches 2.3.1.LO.1 'select the most suitable solution'). Validated: subStrand/learningOutcome/contentStandard/learningIndicator counts unchanged (30/57/36/102), file re-parses as valid JSON, and no content field (descriptions, codes, sources, learning indicators, pre-existing NEEDS_REVIEW flags) was altered - only nesting location plus new reviewNote/extractionStatus metadata.
